# Verse Project Instructions

- This is an Expo managed React Native app using TypeScript and Expo Router.
- Routes live under `src/app`; shared code belongs in `src/components`, `src/hooks`, `src/services`, `src/theme`, `src/utils`, or `src/data`.
- Use `npx expo install` for Expo and React Native dependencies.
- Run `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npx expo-doctor` after changes.
- Verse text must come from the configured public-domain Bible API. Keep mood data as references only.
- Keep user input and cached verses on device. Do not add accounts, tracking, or analytics.
